full_judgment:
2. This civil petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 04.06.2009 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Miscellaneous Appeal No. 289 of 200800 with Civil Rule No. 419 (FM) of 2008 reversing the judgment and order dated 10.07.2008 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, Seventh Court, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 144 of 2005 granting an order of temporary injunction. 

 3. The leave petitioner as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 172 of 2001 praying for declaration of title to the suit land impleading the respondents herein as the defendants. The suit was subsequently transferred to the. Court of the learned Joint District Judge (Arbitration), Seventh court, Dhaka and renumbered as Title Suit No. 144 of 2005. 

 7. By the same judgment, the High Court Division made the Rule absolute in Civil Rule No. 419 (FM) of 2009. The High Court Division also directed the trial Court to dispose of Title Suit No. 144 of 2005 as early as possible, preferably within a period of 6 months from the date of receipt of that order. Against the judgment and order dated 04.06.2009 passed by the High Court Division, the plaintiff-leave-petitioner filed Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 1753 of 2009 before this Division and obtained an ad interim order of stay from the learned Judge-in-Chamber on 15.09.2009.
